data.gender_notes: Roshinah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The One Who Brings the Light of the Moon. The name Roshinah carries the meaning “Light of the Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Malay. Parents who choose Roshinah usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies spiritual enlightenment and guidance from the divine
data.etymology: Roshinah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of the Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Roshinah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Roshinah carries a unique cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it is derived from the Arabic words "ar-Rushan" or "ar-Ru'ashan," which translates to "the one who brings good news" or "the giver of glad tidings." In Islamic tradition, this name is believed to signify the relevance of the lunar cycle and its impact on various aspects of life, such as agriculture, religious rituals, and daily living.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Roshinah lies in its association with the divine light of guidance and wisdom. In Islamic culture and spirituality, the moon is considered a symbol of divine light and wisdom, guiding humans through their spiritual and earthly journeys.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Light of the Moon" symbolizes The One Who Brings the Light of the Moon. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Roshinah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of light of the moon.
